Wild Alone is available now

Welcome to our thrilling third-person dinosuar survival game
As you find yourself stranded on an island overrun by vicious dinosaurs and mutants, you must fight to survive and make your escape. Explore the island's dangerous landscapes, capture and raise dinosaurs to aid your journey, and outsmart the deadly creatures.
